A couple of logistical notes for the agenda:
- If helpful we can split into two back-to-back meetings (45 + 45) — i.e., a focused demo for engineering, then a procurement/security-focused kickoff. That can make the session more targeted.
- Typical procurement onboarding + timeline (high level):
  1) Document exchange (SOC2 summary, DPIA, IP/ownership clarification) — 3–5 business days
  2) Legal & contract review (we provide initial SOW/terms) — 7–14 business days
  3) Security technical review (deep-dive with SE + sample data/tests) — 5–10 business days
  4) Procurement sign-off & PO/commit — variable (7–21 business days)

I’ve attached our SOC2-summary.pdf and a short vendor onboarding checklist. Please let us know any hard procurement deadlines and we’ll prioritize.
